name: 网页拾取
description: 左浏览器 + 右步骤栏：地址栏开页、点选/输入逐步记录，一键生成报告附件送入聊天；AI 经 6 个 web_inspect_* 工具直接读取与落盘。
descriptionEn: Browser left + steps sidebar right: open pages, record clicks/inputs step by step, one click sends a report attachment to chat; AI reads and saves via 6 web_inspect_* tools.

settings.label: 步骤栏默认宽度

settings.hintEn: Right steps sidebar width in px; draggable inside the tab, remembered per browser

settings.hintEn: Automatically capture an element snapshot after opening a same-origin page

settings.hint: 超过后从最旧的开始丢弃
